title: Savory German Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful German pilaf dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines tender rice with savory ingredients and a hint of spice.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the Portuguese, Pilaf, Xerisque, Salt, and Pepper. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
